interpretation: Cold includes artifact load and initialization. Warm is a new calculation in the same process. No completed-result cache. Overlapping planner spans must not be summed.

environment.background: No concurrent heavy verification jobs. Seven runs sampled isolated production-app bursts of 27–34% of ONE CPU (host has eight). Existing healthcheck runs every 15 seconds and observed checks take 0.33–0.36 seconds; this is consistent with the short background bursts, not proof attributing every historical sample. All runs retained, none discarded by latency. Environment is shared, not absolutely background-silent.
environment.cold_definition: Fresh Python process including imports, initial artifact load and serialization; OS disk cache is not flushed. Warm is a new calculation, no saved-result retrieval. CPU fields measure calculation including serialization, not initialization CPU.
